cohort: Women who underwent induction with prostaglandin in all maternity wards in Sweden between May 1996 and December 2019 (n = 56,784)
finding: Multiparous women induced with prostaglandin had an increased risk of uterine rupture compared with nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Multiparous women induced with prostaglandin, especially those without prior cesarean section, had an increased risk of uterine rupture compared to nulliparous or uniparous women.
